name: Lily's Bedroom
description: Soft watercolour / dreamlike palette for the bedroom win-room biome. Intended contrast to the Escher foyer — warm, pastel, organic rather than architectural.
style_notes: Starfield background, moonlit stone, soft pencil outlines rather than hard crosshatch. Colours: deep navy, soft silver, pale gold. Edge contracts identical to escher_foyer so tiles can be mixed across sets.
